setlist.title: It Takes A Lot to Laugh, It Takes A Train to Cry

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Shakedown Street** (6 reviews): Reviewer calls the opening Shakedown shaky, after which the band found their footing and played solidly; Reviewer hears the Shakedown jam as Bruce nearly pushing the band into Dancing in the Streets [12][15][16][17][18][21]
- **Rain** (2 reviews): Reviewer thought the Rain run opening the second set was pretty cool [15][16]
- **Brokedown Palace** (2 reviews): Reviewer finds the Brokedown Palace encore poignant and moving; Reviewer ranks Brokedown among the best of the 90s, with crisp Jerry vocals and a confident solo [13][19]
- **Jack-A-Roe** (1 review): Reviewer praises Jerry's solos in Jack-a-Roe, Mama Tried into Mexicali, and Loose Lucy [19]
- **Loose Lucy** (1 review): Reviewer found Loose Lucy drippy [17]
- **Box of Rain** (1 review): Reviewer says the singer on Box of Rain was awful; Jerry was weak and mostly absent in set one [13]
- **Ship of Fools** (1 review): Reviewer calls Ship of Fools very solid, and Wharf Rat into Not Fade Away excellent [19]
- **Wharf Rat** (1 review): Reviewer names Wharf Rat as a highlight; Brokedown was solid [17]

## The recordings

- **gd1995-06-25.121122.nak300.dunbar-graves.flac1648** (recommended): source not stated; 21 songs; 176 min [1]
- **gd1995-06-25.fob.schoeps.cooper-howard.braveman.27450.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 166 min; rated 3.5/5 by 2 [2]. Said about its sound: Excellent front-of-board recording, very clear, minimal close crowd noise, more low end than the Nak 300 source [2]
- **gd1995-06-25.fob.akg.unknown.swayne.85340.flac1648**: source not stated; 19 songs; 160 min; rated 4.75/5 by 4 [8]. Said about its sound: Uploader calls the quality amazing for an audience recording; Hornsby on piano [8]
- **gd95-06-25.sbd.2236.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 148 min; rated 3.15/5 by 48 [10]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the recording quality somewhat flat; Sound is pretty good, with a little static in places; Recording is very clean, though some cuts sound a bit sharp [11][12][13]

## Around the show

- Bruce Hornsby played piano, but the reviewer still found the show mediocre, though above par for 1995 [11]
- Hornsby added a nice feel but sat fairly low in the mix; Jerry had very few wrong notes or lyric flubs [12]
- Reviewer's 129th and last show; Fall Tour tickets then went on sale [18]
- Reviewer appeared on the videotron during Shakedown while selling t-shirts in the lot [21]
- Bruce Hornsby played piano throughout; Weir played acoustic on Mama Tried and Mexicali Blues [1]
- Dylan opened, and Jerry Garcia played guitar on the two Dylan tunes [1]
- Interactive crowd moments include the We Want Phil and Not Fade Away chants [2]
- Reviewer says most 1995 shows were two-star performances, and this one rates somewhat above that [11]
- Wharf Rat was wrecked at the Meadowlands show a week earlier, but was nailed on the 25th [15]
- Wharf Rat was wrecked at the Meadowlands show a week earlier, but was nailed on the 25th [16]
- Reviewer calls this the better of the two RFK shows, but still awful [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1995-06-25.121122.nak300.dunbar-graves.flac1648**: taped by Robert Dunbar; transferred by Bill Graves; source: flac16/48kHz ; Source: Nak 300's > A/D > D7; [1]. Also: Recording is a Nak 300 source, labeled a Boiler in the Basement installment [1]
- **gd1995-06-25.fob.schoeps.cooper-howard.braveman.27450.flac16**: taped by Tom Cooper and Dave Howard; source: FOB Schoeps mk-4 >kcy >vms021b >d-10pro2 > DATs [2]. Also: About thirty seconds of missing music was patched using another Nak 300 FOB source; Schoeps mics [2]
- **gd1995-06-25.fob.akg.unknown.swayne.85340.flac1648**: transferred by Scott Swayne; source: FOB AKG 300B/CK91 -> DAT ->DAT [8]. Also: Split-second digital zaps in Brokedown Palace were removed; one or two faint anomalies remain; AKG mics [8]
- **gd95-06-25.sbd.2236.sbefail.shnf**: transferred by Bill Bina; source: DSBD> DAT> CDR> EAC> shn [10]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Robert F. Kennedy Stadium - June 24, 1995](https://www.dead.net/show/june-24-1995) [27]
- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1995-06-25 Grateful Dead Backstage Pass - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1995-06-25-grateful-dead-backstage-pass/) [28]
- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1995-06-25 Robert F. Kennedy Stadium, Washington, DC, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1995-06-25-robert-f-kennedy-stadium-washington-dc-usa/) [29]
